paper_title: Axion search with quantum nondemolition detection of magnons
notes: Headline result Eq. (40) and abstract: g_aee < 2.6e-6 at 95% CL, flat over the mass range 33.117 ueV < m_a < 33.130 ueV. Reported as two endpoint points. The paper's g_aee is dimensionless, defined by L = -i g_aee a psi-bar gamma5 psi with g_tilde_aee = g_aee/(2m_e) (Eq. 2), matching the canonical g_ae = C_e m_e/f_a. Assumed local DM density rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and v_tot = 220 km/s; per task card, not rescaled. Data from a reanalysis of the Nakamura/Lachance-Quirion QND magnon dataset (Ref. 28). Constraint shown as the red region in Fig. 4.
